question: How can both nondependence and dependence on conceptual thought appear in the same knower?
premises: Nondependence and dependence on conceptual thought can both occur in the same self.
A jewel expert may see gems only in a flash of lightning at night.
The brief seeing provides the basis for later recognition.
inference: The example of the jewel expert shows that an initial nonconceptual glimpse and subsequent conceptual recognition can coexist in the same knower.
uncertainties: This verse is syntactically linked to the next verse and completes its sense there.
plain_english: Both independence from and dependence on conceptual thought can occur in the same self. For example, even at night a jewel expert may see gems revealed only for the brief moment of a lightning flash.
